misc.privacyS2L4: Images uploaded for waste logging or profile pictures.

misc.privacyS3L2: To post community updates and track eco-friendly progress.
misc.privacyS3L3: To calculate and award points/vouchers for sustainable actions.

scan.tipPlastic: Rinse plastic containers before disposal. Separate mixed materials (e.g. plastic with metal parts) where possible for better recycling.
scan.tipPaper: Keep paper clean and dry before recycling. Oily or wet paper should go to mixed waste or compost if biodegradable.
scan.tipMetal: Empty and rinse metal cans or containers before disposal. Wrap sharp metal items safely to prevent injury during handling.
scan.tipEwaste: Never dispose of electronics, chargers, batteries, or cables in regular bins. Drop them at authorized e-waste collection or recycling centers.
scan.tipOrganic: Place food scraps and biodegradable waste in compost or organic waste bins. Avoid mixing plastic packaging with organic waste.
scan.tipOther: Dispose of contaminated or mixed-material waste in general waste bins if it cannot be separated. Follow local disposal rules when unsure.
defaultSteps: Rinse the bottle thoroughly to remove any liquid residue.
Compress the bottle and place it in the plastic recycling bin.
